purpose: Cross-map useful legacy N0TE behavior against current N0TE2 and turn the comparison into concrete convergence actions without admitting legacy GPL-gated source or violating the active product-code receipt.

preserve_semantics: append-only provenance-aware context
supersession without erasing history
conflict preservation instead of silent winner selection
Song/workspace alias migration that fails closed when ambiguous
corruption is surfaced and routed to recovery rather than normalized to empty state
reject_topology: standalone context JSON ledger as parallel canonical state
legacy project identifiers impersonating durable Song identity
legacy_quarry_findings.reason: N0TE2 ContextIsolationService already binds context to canonical LineageStore and EvidenceMemory, so recreating the legacy ContextEngine store would be duplication.

preserve_semantics: deterministic offline WAV analysis without optional dependencies for core measurements
bounded-memory streaming levels and true-peak path
channel-layout truth including explicit UNKNOWN_CHANNEL_LAYOUT
BS.1770-style loudness claims remain bounded by conformance evidence
sample peak, true peak, RMS, DC, crest, loudness and later spectral/dynamics evidence remain measurement claims rather than taste decisions
reject_topology: calling an algorithm certified before conformance proof
duplicating measurement engines if AUDIO-01/AUDIO-02 current implementations already cover the behavior
legacy_quarry_findings.reason: Current completion graph still preserves AUDIO-01 and AUDIO-02, so these legacy numerical and bounded-memory behaviors are useful acceptance quarry, not authority to create a second audio stack.

preserve_semantics: Artist World is advisory rather than compulsory
artist may use, vary from, or ignore remembered style
identity/visual/sonic/public-voice/content preferences are distinct evidence dimensions
forgetting durable artist memory requires explicit user authority and exact field targeting
creative suggestions should support familiar, adjacent and wildcard exploration instead of trapping the artist in past taste
reject_topology: standalone artist_world.json as a parallel long-term identity authority
silent corruption-to-empty behavior in legacy load path
hard-coded creative pools becoming canonical artistic doctrine
legacy_quarry_findings.reason: ART-01 is preserved and current profile/lineage infrastructure already provides the canonical identity boundary.

preserve_semantics: people, opportunities, jobs, feedback, revisions, packages and financial-status references are artist-work context
business memory should coordinate external evidence rather than pretend to be accounting, payment processing or legal authority
opportunities/jobs remain linkable to Song and person identity
remote/location constraints, waiting-on state, next action, approval and delivery stages are useful operational semantics
reject_topology: business.json as an isolated cross-domain source of truth
local planning state being mislabeled provider-verified financial truth
legacy_quarry_findings.reason: The completion graph already preserves ART-01 and OPS-01 through OPS-06; legacy business semantics should seed those nodes while canonical identity/evidence remain shared.

preserve_semantics: reconstruct truth before editing
select by artist outcome rather than adjacency
one bounded baseline-bound receipt
reuse before invention
red-team closure
systemic repair with sibling/consequence/recurrence scans
globally reselect after each bounded increment
repository entropy rule
reject_topology: controller becoming a second semantic graph
controller accumulating user-facing reasoning or runtime autonomy
controller creating duplicate roadmap/current-state authority documents
legacy_quarry_findings.reason: N0TE2 AGENTS/governance already encode the right separation; future controller growth must stay beneath product meaning.

current_architecture_findings.evidence: ActivityLog, AttentionMemory, FrictionMemory and ContextIsolationService all require the canonical LineageStore; Friction additionally requires canonical LearningMemory and Activity chronology.
current_architecture_findings.action: KEEP. Do not merge these domain services merely because their concepts are adjacent. Audit only duplicated projections, terminology and shell composition.

RETRACT the earlier recommendation to create a new shared event/memory store. The shared substrate already exists. Preserve domain-specific append-only tables and enforce one-way dependencies into canonical Activity chronology.

KEEP ContextIsolationService on LineageStore/EvidenceMemory. Add or verify fresh N0TE2 tests for conflict visibility, explicit supersession semantics, ambiguous legacy alias failure, and corruption visibility/recovery. Do not restore context_engine.json.

current_architecture_findings.evidence: n0te2/consumer_shell.py is a very large composition surface relative to most domain modules.
current_architecture_findings.action: REFACTOR BY EXTRACTION WHEN THE ACTIVE RECEIPT PERMITS: shell keeps HTTP/UI composition, request parsing, presentation and dependency wiring; move domain validation/state transitions into domain services. Add an architecture test forbidding new persistent tables or canonical domain dataclasses in consumer_shell.py.

KEEP both modules only if capabilities owns operational descriptor/availability semantics and capability_evidence owns proof/provenance. Add a regression test that evidence cannot independently mutate support, authority or runtime availability. Merge only if inspection later proves duplicate canonical fields.

Governance files may select/authorize/record construction work only. Add a governance invariant preventing Song, Artist preference, runtime capability health, relationship/business records or user memory from being stored as governance truth.

DO NOT GROW until a narrow contract is found or written under an authorized receipt. N0TED may not own duplicate Artist/Song identity, durable memory, planner, authority, semantic graph or completion graph. If no unique runtime responsibility survives this test, delete/absorb the concept rather than preserve a name.

delete_or_do_not_restore: legacy artist_world.json as canonical identity/memory authority
any future N0TED duplicate planner/memory/authority/semantic graph
merge_or_absorb: legacy ContextEngine semantics into current ContextIsolation/Evidence/Lineage tests rather than another service store
legacy Artist World semantics into ART-01 using canonical profile/evidence lineage
legacy relationship/business semantics into OPS/ART product nodes using shared identities and evidence
legacy audio measurement behaviors into AUDIO-01/AUDIO-02 acceptance requirements rather than a copied engine
refactor: consumer_shell.py toward composition-only boundaries as future domain work lands
make capability operational state versus evidence proof boundary executable with regression tests
keep Activity/Attention/Friction as bounded services while centralizing timeline presentation as projection, not new truth
missing_or_not_yet_closed: ART-01 remains PRESERVED and should carry advisory/forget/anti-style-prison Artist World semantics
OPS-01..OPS-06 remain PRESERVED and should carry relationship/business/release/communication operational semantics without parallel stores
UX-01 remains PRESERVED and is a dependency of active SONG-01
legacy regression gaps still require fresh N0TE2 proof: both network transition directions, exact private-data egress purpose/destination, corruption visibility/recovery, and full consumer lifecycle

execution_order: 1. Preserve this quarry before deleting legacy N0TE.
2. Do not interrupt the currently authorized SONG-01 increment with unrelated product-code refactors.
3. After SONG-01 reconciliation, globally reselect from the completion graph.
4. When UX/domain work naturally touches consumer_shell, extract domain logic instead of adding shell-local state.
5. Before ART-01, OPS-* and AUDIO-* implementation, seed their fresh acceptance tests from the preserved legacy semantics in this audit.
6. Resolve N0TED contract before implementation growth; absorb/delete if it has no non-duplicative responsibility.
7. Red-team the final convergence candidate for duplicate authorities, parallel stores, fake acceptance and controller creep.
